body.name: concurrent-only observed-data minimax benchmark
body.construction: The concurrent record \(O^{\mathrm{cc}}\) retains every assignment and realized predictable propensity vector but retains outcomes only from blocks in \(W\). Define \(\mathcal C_\alpha^{\mathrm{cc}}=\{K\in\mathcal C_\alpha:K(dI\mid O)\text{ is }O^{\mathrm{cc}}\text{-measurable}\}\) and \(\mathfrak L_\alpha^{\mathrm{cc}}=\inf_{K\in\mathcal C_\alpha^{\mathrm{cc}}}\sup_{Y\in\mathcal Y_{M,\Gamma}}\mathbb E^K_{\mathcal D,Y}[\operatorname{len}(I_K)]\). The realized propensities are design metadata needed to evaluate the known randomization law and do not add raw off-window outcomes to the procedure.
